Feature: Is there an overt marker for the absolutive?
curated_comment: Nominative-accusative alignment confirmed: A and S take same case forms; O is distinct. The optional agentive suffix /-wu/ marks non-topic A only and is not an ergative marker (S cannot take it). Grammar explicitly uses nominative-accusative terminology (LaPolla & Huang 2003:§3.2.3). All GB409 values = 0 are correct.
